The '''Meteor Village''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|流星|りゅうせい}}の{{tt|里|さと}}''' ''Meteor Village'') is a location in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. It is a village located within [[Meteor Falls]] and home to the [[Draconid people]], including [[Zinnia]], [[Jinga]], [[Renza]], [[Tomatoma]], and the village [[Elder (Meteor Village)|Elder]].

==History==
The Meteor Village debuted in [[PS610]]. {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Emerald}} awoke in the village, having been taken there after being defeated by the power of [[Primal Reversion|Primal]] {{p|Groudon}} and {{p|Kyogre}}. There, they meet the Elder, who introduces herself and her home to them.
